steps.text: MSI installs silently via msiexec /i ... /qn. The launcher UI is heavy CEF; first start takes minutes. -SkipBuildPatchPrereq avoids a prerequisite loop under Wine.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash on launch from Epic ('Epic Online Services')
knownIssues.fix: DXMT v0.73+ fixed EOS-launched crashes; keep DXMT current

lastVerified.result: silent MSI install OK in 90 s; launcher installed to Program Files/Epic Games (Win64); login not yet tested
